snippet.title: Don't Scream Together - Official Announcement Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Here's your look at the Don't Scream Together announcement teaser trailer for the upcoming online co-op jumpscare horror simulator where you and friends walk through a pitch-black forest with camcorders in 1993. 

Use proximity voice chat and escape the forest. But if anyone screams or speaks too loudly, the game restarts or the screamer returns as the hunter! 

Don't Scream Together will be available on PC.

#DontScreamTogether #Horror #Multiplayer
